comment: One entry per tool. mode: 'confirm' = client must ask the user before each call; 'auto' = pre-approved; anything else (e.g. 'deny') = the server refuses to run the tool at all. A tool with no entry here is also refused. Start everything on 'confirm'; loosen individually once proven reliable.

get_chuck_bird_status.notes: Read-only SSH to the bot's prod box: systemctl is-active + journalctl grep. No writes.

list_recent_project_files.notes: Lists file names/mtimes under a path inside the user's home dir. Does not read file contents.
